ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, A, D, F, G, E, B are on the same horizontal straight line, C is above, and connecting C to these base points forms multiple small triangles. Angle 3 is located at vertex C, between CF and CG. Near the base, point F is marked with 77°, indicating the angle ∠CFG of triangle FCG at point F. Then reason: The problem states that triangle FCG is an isosceles triangle; according to the direction shown in the figure, CF = CG, so FG is the base, and the base angles ∠CFG and ∠CGF are equal. Given ∠CFG = 77°, therefore ∠CGF = 77°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so angle 3 = ∠FCG = 180° - 77° - 77° = 26°.

method.method_draft: Direct local triangle route: From the image, note that points F and G lie on the same horizontal base line and angle 3 is the angle at C between CF and CG. The marked 77° is the angle at F of triangle FCG, namely ∠CFG. From the text, triangle FCG is isosceles; using the diagram’s intended orientation, CF = CG, so FG is the base. Therefore the base angles at F and G are equal, so ∠CFG = ∠CGF = 77°. By the triangle angle sum in triangle FCG, angle 3 = 180° - 77° - 77° = 26°.

method.method_draft: Central-angle subtraction route: From the image, angle 3 lies inside the larger angle ∠DCE, which is split into angles 2, 3, and 4. The text says triangle DCE is equilateral, so ∠DCE = 60°, hence angle 2 + angle 3 + angle 4 = 60°. The marked 77° is ∠CFG. Since triangle FCG is isosceles with CF = CG, the other base angle ∠CGF is also 77°. Because D, F, G, E are collinear, ∠CFD is supplementary to ∠CFG, so ∠CFD = 103°, and ∠CGE is supplementary to ∠CGF, so ∠CGE = 103°. In equilateral triangle DCE, ∠CDE = ∠CED = 60°; using the collinear base, ∠CDF = 60° and ∠CEG = 60°. Then in triangle CDF, angle 2 = 180° - 103° - 60° = 17°. Similarly, in triangle CGE, angle 4 = 180° - 103° - 60° = 17°. Therefore angle 3 = 60° - 17° - 17° = 26°.

推理：因为 △DCE 是等边三角形，所以 ∠DCE = 60°。在图中，∠DCE 被分成角 2、角 3、角 4，因此 angle 2 + angle 3 + angle 4 = 60°。又因为 △FCG 是等腰三角形，且图中 77° 是 ∠CFG，所以另一个底角 ∠CGF 也等于 77°。由于 D、F、G、E 共线，∠CFD 与 ∠CFG 互补，所以 ∠CFD = 180° - 77° = 103°；同理 ∠CGE = 180° - 77° = 103°。在等边三角形 DCE 中，∠CDE = ∠CED = 60°，而 F、G 位于 DE 所在直线上，所以 ∠CDF = 60°，∠CEG = 60°。在 △CDF 中，角 2 = 180° - 103° - 60° = 17°。在 △CGE 中，角 4 = 180° - 103° - 60° = 17°。因此角 3 = 60° - 17° - 17° = 26°。
